title: What Is Symbolism? — A Literary Guide for English Teachers and Students
skills: distinguish literal meaning from symbolic meaning
analyze how symbols contribute to theme and characterization
support interpretations of symbolism with textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces symbolism as a literary device in which objects, images, characters, or events carry meanings beyond their literal significance. Supports close reading, thematic analysis, interpretation of author's craft, and evidence-based literary analysis across high school English courses.
